content: Career-advice sites (The Muse, Kickresume, FlexJobs) agree hiring managers who view a portfolio site want: proof of skills via projects with explained decisions/outcomes, a short professional bio, specific measurable accomplishments, and easy-to-find contact info. Oft-repeated but unsourced stat: '86% of employers visit a portfolio site if offered, 71% say quality influences decision' - treat as marketing folklore, not verified.
